scenarioPremise: A goat starts high on an alpine rock face and works its way downward one deliberate foothold at a time. The musical prompt mirrors Rocky Ascent in reverse: every scale fragment descends from the octave root b1 toward 1. Higher levels make the route steeper, tighter, faster, and more absurdly exposed.

runTransposition.note: One octave, root to root. `b1` is the octave root above `1`; there is no second band.

goodNoteBehavior: advance downward to next authored waypoint
orient/flip the static goat pose as needed to read as downhill movement
show fx_rocky_descent_tick for Perfect, optionally smaller for Good
badNoteBehavior: briefly wobble active goat pose and return to the same transform
minigameCompleteBehavior: if passed, show goat_rocky_descent_finish at prop_rocky_descent_goal on the lower ledge
otherwise freeze at furthest earned waypoint

assets.sourceSelection: Reuse the same mountain/background source family as Rocky Ascent, but compose the readable route from upper-left/upper-center toward the lower-right/lower-center.

productionNotes: Reuse the Rocky Ascent art conventions; only the route direction and framing change.
Do not animate the source strips/GIFs as traditional animation. Extract individual frames and treat them as independent static billboards.
Rocky Descent is a control scene, not a falling scene: even L4 should read as absurd deliberate footwork rather than a tumble.
One successful note opportunity advances exactly one waypoint.
The exercise is one octave, root to root.

nonBlockingTBD: Star thresholds are authored but PROVISIONAL — see each level's `stars.note`.
Phrases and (for Rocky Ascent) waypoint coordinates are regenerable via scripts/author-rocky-scenarios.mjs.

visual.destinationTreatment: safe lower ledge/base marker visible and comfortably close
visual.waypointGeneration: one authored waypoint per successful note opportunity; reuse prop_rocky_descent_step
visual.sustainBehavior: after advancing on a sustained note, hold the current descent pose/position through the note duration

route.space: normalised scenario space: x rightwards 0..1, y downwards 0..1 (0 = top of frame)

stars.metricNote: Cumulative judgment points during the attempt: Perfect 10, Good 6, Miss 0 (src/config/tuning.ts JUDGMENT_POINTS). Thresholds are cumulative and lock once earned.
stars.note: PROVISIONAL. The design left thresholds TBD. Pass is 45% and two stars 80% of the all-Perfect maximum (160); three stars is the maximum itself, so ★★★ requires every note opportunity taken at Perfect.

scoring.note: Scale material is not streak-eligible content (GDD §9.2 points streaks at triplets and sixteenth runs). The streak is still tracked and shown in the debug panel.
